name: chernobyl
description: CHERNOBYL — one interface. Every agent. Monorepo: shared protocol, Node host service, Expo mobile app.

scripts.build:protocol: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w @chernobyl/protocol
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build:protocol && npm run build -w @chernobyl/e2e
scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:e2e && npm run build:host
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck -w @chernobyl/e2e && npm run typecheck -w @chernobyl/host && npm run typecheck -w @chernobyl/adapter-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @chernobyl/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w @chernobyl/domain && npm run test -w @chernobyl/protocol && npm run test -w @chernobyl/host && npm run test -w @chernobyl/adapter-sdk && npm run test -w @chernobyl/e2e && npm run test -w @chernobyl/mobile
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:mobile
scripts.verify:rust: cargo test --manifest-path services/companion-rs/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path services/companion-rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --manifest-path services/companion-rs/Cargo.toml --check && cargo run --quiet --manifest-path services/companion-rs/Cargo.toml -- --self-test
